claim: The legacy correspondence says that the runtime records an external-owner reference, overstating specifications whose runtime gate does not establish an implementation.

evidence.quote:
The present repository offers two non-canonical correspondence variants. In runtime-managed flows,
ACI owns the confirmed Dispatch authority and APT refers to the corresponding authority snapshot.
In legacy-managed flows, the accepted authority remains with the legacy ledger and the runtime
records an external-owner reference rather than duplicating it. These names describe current
repository mechanisms; they do not select the general architecture or establish a future contract.

minimal_fix: Use specification language: ACI specifies legacy-ledger authority and APT specifies a legacy_ledger external-owner reference; do not claim that a runtime records it.
